messages:
Maria: Quick sync — need final pass on landing copy + launch ops for the tri-mode pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Checklist: hero lines, 1-pager benchmark narrative, webinar date + registration flow, inbound routing to sales. Can people flag what they own by EOD Thu? :spiral_calendar:

Aj: I can own the launch posts + 3 social variants. Will do LinkedIn long + 2 short X posts. Need 2 headline options per page (demo CTA vs try-now).

Noah: Webinar: Wed June 12 10am PT or Thu June 13 1pm PT — leaning Wed. Agenda: product demo (20m), benchmark walk (10m), Q&A (20m). Ping me if block on timing.

Sam: Design will produce hero comps for all three pages + webinar banner. Need final H1/H2 before EOD Wed so we can A/B art. Also share image aspect and CTA button copy.

Rachel: Drafting copy — initial H1 options: "Low-latency inference for production" (Hosted), "Predictable throughput for heavy workloads" (Dedicated), "Private deployments for compliance" (Private). Will push alternate verbs + benefit lines.

Priya: Inbound routing: HubSpot form to include `product_interest` dropdown (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), `company_size`, `contact_stage`. For high-intent (product_interest != Hosted OR company_size > 100) create workflow to notify #sales-inbound and add to AE queue. Sample UTM: `?utm_source=launch&utm_campaign=tri_mode_q3&utm_medium=web`.

Ben: Webinar ops: Zoom Webinar + recording, will set up registration page. Need list of panelists + bios. I'll also configure auto-email with calendar attach and replay link.

Nadia: For the benchmark narrative, let's lead with three pillars: latency (p95), cost/unit, and reliability/fallbacks. Bullet example: "Avg p95 < 250ms on Hosted for 16k token bursts; 2–4x unit cost savings with caching and quantization profiles" — I'll draft conservative language and call out test harness.

Maria: Thanks — assign owners: Aj = social + posts, Rachel = copyfinal, Sam = hero art, Priya = forms + routing, Ben = webinar ops, Nadia = benchmark one-pager, Noah = webinar schedule + runbook. Can everyone drop a thumbs in thread when done? Deadline: copy/design by Wed EOD, benchmark + routing by Thu midday. :thumbsup:

Aj: thumbs. I'll post sample LinkedIn copy by noon tomorrow.

Rachel: will circulate copy variants in the doc — expect comments by Wed morning.

Sam: noted — will upload comps to Drive by Wed 6pm PT.

Priya: I’ll set up HubSpot fields and workflows, will share playbook link once done.

Ben: Registering Zoom now, will share host/co-host invites.

Nadia: Drafting benchmark now, will add methodology appendix.

Maria: Perfect — I'll collate into a single launch checklist and run a 15m sync Friday morning. Thanks team!
